title: Did not fit Ziplock gallon bags
text: Did not fit Ziplock gallon bags. Like many others, I've been wanting to join the band wagon and get a set of nice wooden boxes to hold my Ziplock bags so I could ditch the store boxes and have a more put together look in my kitchen. Well, I've tried this twice now (with this set and one other) and both failed for me. This set was perfect, that is, until I tried putting my gallon Ziplock bags inside. The box was ever so slightly too short - causing the bags to rise with an unsightly hump in the middle and not lay flat enough to clear the top of the drawer. Well, crap. Back to the drawing board. Was explaining them (and my frustration with them) to my mother-in-law when she asked if she could have them. I'm not sure what she used them for, but she repurposed them for some kind of artsy crafty project. Bottom line, they are a nice set of storage boxes, well made, sturdy.. just be sure to take all measurements into account before ordering and know that, despite the given measurements, the gallon box is TOO SMALL for Ziplock brand gallon bags.
